components.name: Accordion
components.description: Sections that open and close one above the other, Up and Down moving between their headers: a section of a grouped form on macOS, as NSBox and System Settings draw it, Expander cards 4 DIPs apart on Windows 11, or a boxed list on GNOME. The headers and their arrows are MyGo's.

components.name: AccordionItem
components.description: A section of an Accordion: a row under a separator inset 10 points on macOS, an Expander's card on Windows 11, a row of a boxed list on GNOME; its header is MyGo's.

components.name: CheckboxGroup
components.description: A check box over the check boxes it groups, checked when they all are and mixed when some are: the platform's check box, with macOS's mixed dash, Windows 11's indeterminate glyph or GNOME's dash.svg, over the boxes built with breeze.Checkbox, indented below its label (24 DIPs on Windows 11, as WinUI Gallery's three-state sample). Rebuilt on ui.CheckboxBase; it counts only the boxes built with breeze.Checkbox.

components.name: Collapsible
components.description: A disclosure showing its content while open: macOS's disclosure chevron beside its label, Windows 11's Expander with its header card and chevron button, or GNOME's GtkExpander arrow.

components.name: Fieldset
components.description: A group of fields under a legend: a grouped form section on macOS (NSBox's fill), the fields under a Body Strong header on Windows 11, which has no group box, or a card under an AdwPreferencesGroup's bold title on GNOME.

components.name: Form
components.description: A column of fields: the labels in a column before the controls on macOS and GNOME, as ui.Form lays them out, and above the controls on Windows 11, 12 DIPs between fields, as its controls take their headers.

components.name: Scroll
components.description: A container scrolling its children vertically: package ui's, its scroll bar painted by MyGo in the platform's scroll bar color and width (the overlay knob's black or white at 50% on macOS, WinUI's ScrollBarThumbFill, GNOME's 3-pixel slider at 20%). MyGo paints the bar itself from the theme alone, so its thickness, track, arrows and growth under the pointer are MyGo's on every platform.

components.name: ScrollBoth
components.description: A container scrolling its children both ways, as a canvas or a wide table does: package ui's, its two scroll bars painted by MyGo in the platform's scroll bar color and width, as Scroll's.

components.name: ScrollHorizontal
components.description: A row scrolling its children horizontally: package ui's, its scroll bar painted by MyGo in the platform's scroll bar color and width, as Scroll's.

components.name: Split
components.description: Two panes side by side with a divider that a drag or the arrows move: MyGo's 1-DIP line in the theme's border color, 1 wide as NSSplitView's thin divider and GtkPaned's separator are, which stays that color under the pointer and while dragged, as on every platform, where MyGo's turns to the accent. It grabs 6 DIPs.

components.name: SplitPercent
components.description: Split with the first pane's share of the room in percent, its divider in the border color under the pointer too.

components.name: SplitVertical
components.description: Split with the first pane above the second, its divider in the border color under the pointer too.

components.name: SplitVerticalPercent
components.description: SplitPercent with the first pane above the second, its divider in the border color under the pointer too.
